subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should progress mode expose model preambles as an always-on Discord and Telegram headline when commentary is disabled, or should this PR preserve the existing default and limit itself to the timing and narration-cost repair?
rationale: The headline changes default user-visible behavior and overlaps the existing opt-in commentary contract; repository policy requires explicit ownership of that compatibility and UX choice.

options.title: Split the default change
options.body: Land the time-gate and deferred-narration fix while keeping automatic model headlines out until a separately approved behavior contract exists.

options.title: Approve always-on headlines
options.body: Keep the headline design, explicitly own the default-behavior change, and require the remaining lifecycle repairs plus live Discord and Telegram proof before merge.

recommendation.title: Split the default change
recommendation.body: Land the time-gate and deferred-narration fix while keeping automatic model headlines out until a separately approved behavior contract exists.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature history, linked issue, protected maintainer signal, and implementation series place the product contract with steipete.
